ValidationRule.description: Credit Limit cannot be changed if BP Action not equal to Insert
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: ISCHANGED(UKMBP_CMS_SGM_CREDIT_LIMIT__c) && ISPICKVAL(BP_Action__c, "U")|| ISCHANGED(UKMBP_CMS_SGM_CREDIT_LIMIT__c) && ISPICKVAL(BP_Action__c, "C")|| ISCHANGED(UKMBP_CMS_SGM_CREDIT_LIMIT__c) && ISPICKVAL(BP_Action__c, "M")
ValidationRule.errorMessage:
You cannot change the Credit limit once it has initially been set on BP Insert.
Should the Credit Limit be changed, please do so directly in CFIN.
